preconditions.description: The length of the sequence S is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '0123456789' for c in S)
preconditions.description: Each character in the sequence S is a digit from 0 to 9.

postconditions.description: The output is an integer representing the minimal number of jumps.
The minimal number of jumps is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: output == min(jumps_to_reach(S, i) for i in range(len(S)))
postconditions.description: The output is the minimal number of jumps required to reach the last digit from the first digit.
